# Skill creator (Anthropic)

Design, test and tune your own Agent Skills, including evals and description tuning.

- Source: https://github.com/anthropics/skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/skills/main/skills/skill-creator/SKILL.md
- Author: Anthropic
- License: Apache-2.0
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/skill-creator-anthropic-4085d6b7

Walks Claude through writing a new skill or improving an existing one, from interviewing you about the task to drafting SKILL.md and supporting files. It can run test prompts with and without the skill, grade the results, show them in an included eval viewer, and benchmark variance across runs. It also optimizes the description field so the skill triggers at the right times. Bundles agent prompts, scripts and an HTML review viewer; some advanced steps need subagent support.

**Try asking:**
- "Help me turn our release checklist into a skill"
- "My invoice skill isn't triggering when it should, can you fix the description?"
- "Run evals comparing the old and new version of my skill"

**Source:** [anthropics/skills](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/HEAD/skills/skill-creator) · Apache-2.0 · by Anthropic
